prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Pasadena, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported concussion. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1430; do not mention it.)
text: On arrival at the scene in Pasadena, Texas, I observed two vehicles stopped in the right and center lanes of the roadway with visible contact damage to the driver side of Vehicle 1 and the passenger side of Vehicle 2. Driver 1 stated that they were traveling in the center lane and began to change lanes to the right when Vehicle 2 moved into the same space, causing a sideswipe collision. Driver 2 stated that they had checked the mirror before moving over and did not see Vehicle 1 alongside them. Passenger, seated in the front seat of Vehicle 2, stated they were not injured. Driver 1 reported being dazed after the impact and complained of headache and dizziness, and stated they believed they had experienced a concussion. Driver 1 was evaluated by responding medical personnel and transported for further care. Both vehicles were drivable prior to towing. No citations were issued at the scene pending further investigation. Traffic was redirected around the scene until the lanes were cleared.
